row.name: Anticipation
row.effect: Requires Echani Martial Arts. Against an opponent you have already traded blows with this combat: +1 to Active Defenses against that opponent until the end of your next turn.

levels.name: Anticipation
levels.effect: Requires Echani Martial Arts. Against an opponent you have already traded blows with this combat: +1 to Active Defenses against that opponent until the end of your next turn.

levels.name: Anticipation
levels.effect: As Tier 1, but +2. The GM also tells you which combat skill that opponent is strongest in.

levels.name: Anticipation
levels.effect: As Tier 1, but +3, and the bonus applies to your next attack roll against them as well as your defenses.

levels.name: Anticipation
levels.effect: As Tier 1, but +4, applying to both attack and defense. On a successful defense that beats the attack roll by 5 or more, you may immediately make one free unarmed attack against that opponent at no penalty.
